summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Silicon Motion Technology Corporation reporting its quarterly financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains a press release detailing GAAP and non-GAAP financial highlights, including net sales of $342.1 million, gross margin of 47.1%, and earnings per diluted ADS of $1.97. It provides business segment performance commentary on SSD controllers, eMMC+UFS controllers, and Ferri Boot Drive solutions. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist campaign is disclosed. There are no deal terms, tender offers, or strategic review announcements. This is a routine earnings release filed by a foreign private issuer.
